summary: University of Groningen, The Netherlands, PhD candidate in computational linguistics, expertise in natural language processing and machine learning, strong interest in functional programming (Haskell, OCaml), active in open-source software development, engaged in meditation and Buddhist philosophy, vegetarian, critical of corporate practices and digital rights issues, frequent user of GitHub and various programming communities, advocates for social welfare systems, particularly in Western Europe, has experience with multiple programming languages (C, C++, Python, Ruby, Prolog), involved in discussions about software licensing and open-source ethics.
